technical_requirements:
- Long-context support: expected effective context handling up to ~100k tokens via document chunking or prefix caching.
- Rate targets: typical session 6-10 req/sec per user during active typing; plan for 50 concurrent active sessions -> target sustained 300-500 RPS with bursts to 1k.
- Latency: streaming first-token <250-500ms for small completions; end-to-end summarize ops can be slower.
- SDK: official JS + Python examples with streaming, reconnection, chunked uploads, and example batching middleware.
- Observability: need per-route latency/cost breakdowns and token-level billing for optimization.
- Auth: OAuth for app users; future SSO (SAML) for enterprise customers.
